title: National Webinar on Quantum and Particle Physics
teaser: National webinar on Quantum and Particle Physics, jointly organised by tAcT and Brahmananda Keshab Chandra College, Kolkata. Speakers: Prof. Srubabati Goswami on neutrinos, and Prof. Sushanta Dattagupta on graphene and quantum mechanics.
homepageMatter: On 29 August 2020, tAcT and Brahmananda Keshab Chandra College, Kolkata, jointly organised a national webinar on Quantum and Particle Physics. Prof. Srubabati Goswami (PRL) spoke on neutrinos as invisible messengers from space, and Prof. Sushanta Dattagupta explored how graphene can be used to teach quantum mechanics.
